RUNNER's extraction obligation parks checklist-accuracy findings on the anchor; the maintainer asked for them as issues, so the wave's findings are split into one card per ledger file and the anchor links each card. This is not a release blocker, so it carries no `target:v18`.

**Reader who acts:** the lane owning `docs/qa/platform-checklist/**` (`domain:devx`). Dedupe (open and closed): no card holds these lines; the 18.0 precedent closed its accuracy rows on its anchor #24579.

## Wanted

For each line below, edit `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json`: revise the item's text, bump its `revision`, and append a `history` entry citing the run record the line comes from. Keep `pnpm check:platform-checklist` green. A line that turns out to describe a product defect rather than stale text gets its own card instead of a ledger edit.

## Findings (9)

### From #25815 — `release-18.2.0-tier1`, 156 items, at `6679644a`, pin `b41ed7f68956` (clause labels: aK = acceptance[K], nK = negative[K])

- `studio-authoring.expression-editors` a0-a6: every pin in the ref is a jsdom component/unit test; it holds evidence for the editor's lint, inference, completion and test-run logic but scores none of the screenshot/dom/api clauses
- `studio-authoring.meta-save-preconditions-and-draft-rows` a1-a3: every pin stops above HTTP (RestServer with createMockServer, HttpDispatcher.dispatch called directly, objectql repository/protocol units) — the api-oracle clauses stay the run's live leg
- `studio-authoring.metadata-diagnostics-sweep` a3/n0: the ref says the pin covers the outage clause ONLY, but its '[#8924] a caller error the producer classified is refused loudly' describe asserts the ?type= misspelling refusal at the protocol layer — unclaimed protocol-layer evidence; the api-oracle clauses still need the REST door.
- `studio-authoring.object-designer-roundtrip` a3: F4 seeds one real option, not the three the clause judges with, and never publishes — the ref says so; the banner half is pinned under a different fixture than the clause states.
- `studio-authoring.org-override-registry-gate` all clauses are api-oracle but the only pin (overlay-precedence.test.ts) is a unit test of the overlay whitelist (describe 'overlay whitelist enforcement (shared-DB invariant)'), stopping above the HTTP door; it corroborates a0/a2/a3/n0 and scores none; no pin touches a4's DELETE reset
- `studio-authoring.permission-matrix-editor-ux` fieldBulk.test.tsx asserts filter narrowing, the '2 / 8' counter and bulk scope as jsdom checkbox states — evidence for a0/a1 at the component layer, but never the SAVED fields map that a2/a3/n0 make the authority
- `studio-authoring.permission-matrix-editor-ux` a5: readonly.test.tsx covers the package and type gates and a capability gate; the artifact gate ('provided by a code package') sits in PermissionMatrixEditor.artifactTier.test.tsx, not in the ref
- `studio-authoring.record-page-roundtrip` ref cites console pin cf153eb2e535 for the reading; the run's objectui pin is b41ed7f68956 (both specs present and asserting as described)
- `studio-authoring.save-door-runs-authoring-rules` a1-a3/n0: none of the eight pins boots HTTP (metadata-protocol saveMetaItem, objectql, spec, lint units and a RestServer unit) — the api clauses stay the run's

## Acceptance

- Every line above is either applied (item revised, `revision` bumped, `history` cites the record) or answered on this card with the reason it was not.
- `pnpm check:platform-checklist` is green.
- The PR links this card and #25807.
